description: This file defines the TaskDao interface, which provides database operations for TaskEntity objects within a Room database setup. It includes queries for fetching, searching, inserting, updating, and deleting tasks, as well as retrieving tasks by ID and due date.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for managing TaskEntity objects in the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks ordered by due date, null due dates last, then by ID descending.

methods.name: searchAndFilter
methods.description: Searches tasks matching a query in title or description, and filters by category if provided. Returns tasks ordered by due date, null due dates last, then by ID descending.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the database and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a task by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getDueBy
methods.description: Retrieves tasks that are due by a specified time and are not completed.
